# Codemap - issue 0147, round 14: the pinned gap `self-scope-max-house-rules`

The issue fences the scope hard: only `src/evaluator/` production code and its
unit tests may change. Nothing under `docs/testing/` is touched - its `.ros`
files, `scenario.json` and `README.md` are the specification, and
`docs/testing/campaign-state.json` belongs to the campaign driver, not to this
fix.

What the scenario demands, in one sentence: a `max` constraint with
`scope="self"` makes its own carrier selection the counting frame and counts the
selections underneath it, so `714b-5314-33d4-dd68` on `Allow Mercenaries`
(`fda5-49b9-b74c-aaf4`) must fire with actual 2 against bound 1 in rosters 01 and
06 and stay silent in 02-05. Today it never fires in any of the six rosters.

## Likely to change

- `src/evaluator/constraints.js` - turns each declared limit into a count query
  and a violation; it is where a limit's scope, counted target and flags are
  bound before the count is asked, and where the `self`-scoped `max` is decided.
- `src/evaluator/query.js` - the single counting primitive: resolves a scope
  keyword to its frame node and reads that frame's tally, including the gate
  that decides when the frame's own share belongs to the answer.
- `src/evaluator/countIndex.js` - builds the per-frame tallies and holds the
  separate frame-own slot that the `self` frame reads, with the nesting and
  force-crossing buckets behind `includeChildSelections`.
- `src/evaluator/model.js` - carries the scope keywords and the limit/flag
  shapes that the constraint and counting path pass around; touched only if the
  fix needs a distinction the model does not yet express.
- `src/evaluator/CLAUDE.md` - the evaluator's living rule notes; every earlier
  round of this issue recorded its counting-frame decision here.

## Existing unit tests that pin today's behaviour

- `src/evaluator/countIndex.frameOwnAnyTarget.test.js` - its control cases pin a
  `scope="self"` `max` and a `scope="self"` condition against the frame-own slot.
- `src/evaluator/countIndex.costSumCarrierFrame.test.js` - pins cost counting in
  the `scope="self"` frame under both `includeChildSelections` settings.
- `src/evaluator/query.matrix.test.js` - the scope/target/flag matrix of the
  counting primitive, `SELF` among its rows.
- `src/evaluator/constraints.test.js`, `src/evaluator/constraints.carrierDescendants.test.js` -
  pin which selections a limit counts under its carrier.
- `src/evaluator/violationClassification.test.js` - pins the reported shape of a
  `scope="self"` limit's violation.

A new unit test file under `src/evaluator/` for the fixed behaviour is expected;
the researcher decides its shape.

## Read-only, the specification and the check surface

- `docs/testing/self-scope-max-house-rules/` - `README.md`, `scenario.json` and
  the six `rosters/*.ros`: the specification, never edited.
- `src/evaluator/e2e.testcatalog.test.js` - the manifest-driven runner that
  executes the scenario under `npx vitest run src/evaluator`; not changed by this
  issue.
- `src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/` - the frozen catalog data the
  scenario reads (`.gst` plus the Ogre Kingdoms and Mercenaries `.cat`); never
  edited.

increments.title: A self-scoped max counts what stands under its carrier
increments.goal: Make `docs/testing/self-scope-max-house-rules` green in all six of its cases. A `max` constraint with `scope="self"` must take its own carrier selection as the counting frame and count the selections underneath it - with `includeChildSelections="false"`, its direct children. So `714b-5314-33d4-dd68` on `Allow Mercenaries` (`fda5-49b9-b74c-aaf4`) fires with actual 2 against bound 1 both when the carrier holds its two hidden house-rule children (`713c-28b1-0861-1ffd`, `698e-c660-5c99-d481`) and when it holds a single child node with `number="2"`, and stays silent at 1 or 0 children. Today it fires in none of the six rosters, so the limit is not merely counting in the wrong frame - it never speaks at all. Roster 05 delimits the frame from the outside: there the PARENT entry holds two direct children while the carrier holds one, and the limit must stay silent, so counting in the parent frame is not the fix. The whole issue is this one change; it is not split, because the two red cases are two readings of one counting rule and neither stands as a reviewable change on its own.
criteria: `npx vitest run src/evaluator` passes all six cases of `docs/testing/self-scope-max-house-rules`.

In `rosters/01-both-house-rules-self-max-fires.ros` and `rosters/06-single-house-rule-number-two-self-max-fires.ros` the report carries a violation for limit `714b-5314-33d4-dd68` with actual 2 and bound 1.

In `rosters/02`, `03`, `04` and `05` no violation for `714b-5314-33d4-dd68` is reported - roster 05 in particular, where the carrier's parent holds two direct children and the carrier itself holds one.
The parent-scoped sibling limit `1df9-8159-156a-641f` is absent from the report in all six rosters.
`npx vitest run src/evaluator` exits 0 with no failing case anywhere else in the evaluator suite - every scenario green before the change is green after it.
Only files under `src/evaluator/` are changed; nothing under `docs/testing/` is modified, added or deleted.
